Extract product parameters from this datasheet.

Allowed parameters (name | unit | meaning):
- cells_per_pack | unit | Number of cells in the pack
- capacity_mah | mAh | Rated capacity of the pack
- charge_current_ma | mA | Charge current used in the capacity test
- discharge_current_ma | mA | Discharge current used in the capacity test
- n_screws | unit | Enclosure screws per unit
- n_solder_joints | unit | Pack-to-PCBA solder joints (incl. thermistor)
- n_labels | unit | Labels applied per unit (rating and QR)
- n_leds | unit | Indicator LEDs
- n_ports | unit | Output and input ports
- units_per_carton | unit | Unit boxes per shipper carton

Variants:
- PB10K: Power bank 10,000 mAh
- PB20K: Power bank 20,000 mAh

Rules:
- Use only values the text states. Do not guess or calculate. Skip parameters it does not state.
- "evidence" must copy the exact words from the text that state the value.
- "variant" is the variant code the value applies to, or null when it applies to every variant.
- Give "value" as a plain number in the unit listed for that parameter.
- "page" is the page number where the value appears.
- If the datasheet is about one variant, use that variant's code.
- "other_specs": up to 15 further specifications with name, value, unit, page.
